source: NSE bhavcopy closes (corp-action adjusted, survivorship-free sf bin), daily era 20020102+; point-in-time Nifty 500 and F&O rosters from dash_slim.bin

conventions.pct200: 100*a200/n200; null while n200==0 (engine e16 smaBarsAt: SMA of the last 200 TRADING sessions incl. today, null until 200 exist; daily-era bars only)
conventions.advDec: adv/dec vs the member's own previous daily-era close; flat = nAD-adv-dec
conventions.hiLo: close == max/min close of the trailing 252 sessions incl. today (ties count); eligible when n52 sessions exist
conventions.roster: DUMMY* and DVR names dropped; roster name used as-is when it is a bin key, else folded via _rename_map chained; unresolved names stay in nMem
conventions.coverage: nMem = roster size, nObs = members with a positive close that day; nMem-nObs = unresolved + not traded + zero-close
